entries.1684696ac51239e7: This is a business that mainly sells wear-resistant tools, such as can-making tools, to domestic can manufacturers. Wear-resistant tools are custom products used to shape materials into tool forms through plastic working, and are required to withstand heat, pressure and friction. It also sells crushing blades for the paper and environmental recycling industries, molds and consumable parts for the battery industry, and blade dies for bag-making machine manufacturers. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 is ¥2,259 million.

entries.2ecfe30d9fb8cc4a: Since its founding in 1950, the company's basic policy has been to contribute to the development of society by contributing to its customers' productivity improvement, and it states its raison d'être as: “Stay close to all those involved in manufacturing and create ‘can-do’ for the world.” Under its New Medium- to Long-Term Management Plan “Rolling Plan” (FY76-FY80), the company has adopted as its basic policy “Transformation into a highly specialized trading company that contributes to genuine productivity improvement.” Based on five strategic pillars of “sustainable growth” and “reform,” it is working on expansion into growth fields and new areas, continued promotion of M&A and maximization of synergies, operational efficiency through DX promotion, and strengthening of sustainability management.

entries.b41ca08481bb1495: In the Cutting Tools Business, under a 2-division structure of direct sales and wholesale that has been in place since the company's founding, it combines face-to-face direct sales to large companies with deliveries to small and medium-sized metalworking companies through a network of dealers. By linking 2 logistics centers, in Osaka and northern Kanto, with the internet order system “Cominix On-Line,” it has built a rapid-delivery system that allows customers to check inventory and place orders. The company has maintained an exclusive sales agreement with Sumitomo Electric Industries since 1954, and carries a wide variety of products from domestic and overseas manufacturers, including its Igetaloy brand.
